summary: Grindr Inc. filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing a Securities Purchase Agreement for its wholly owned subsidiary to acquire all outstanding shares of PurposeMed Inc., parent of telehealth brand Freddie, for a $250 million base price. Consideration comprises $190 million cash and $60 million in 3,851,684 Grindr shares valued at $15.58 each (15-day VWAP through September 29, 2026), plus up to $70 million cash earnout tied to FY2027 targets. Shares are locked up 12 months post-closing. Buyer-side rep and warranty insurance limits recourse. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch regulatory approvals, integration, and earnout achievement risk against Grindr's equity overhang.
